question: There are two circles of radii r₁ and r₂ (r₁ < r₂). The area of the bigger circle is 693/2 cm². The difference of their circumferences is 22 cm. What is the sum of the diameters of the two circles?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Area of larger circle = π × D₂² / 4 = 693 / 2 ⇒ D₂² = (693/2) × (4 × 7/22) = 441 ⇒ D₂ = 21 cm.

Difference in circumferences = πD₂ − πD₁ = 22 cm.

D₂ − D₁ = 22 × (7/22) = 7 cm.

Smaller diameter D₁ = D₂ − 7 = 21 − 7 = 14 cm.

Sum of diameters = D₁ + D₂ = 14 + 21 = 35 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 35 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

⇒ r₂² = (63 × 7) / (2 × 2) = 441/4

⇒ r₂ = √(441/4) = 21/2 = 10.5 cm

⇒ Difference of circumferences = 2πr₂ − 2πr₁ = 22

⇒ 2 × (22/7) × (r₂ − r₁) = 22

⇒ (44/7) × (r₂ − r₁) = 22

⇒ r₂ − r₁ = 22 × (7/44) = 7/2 = 3.5 cm

⇒ 10.5 − r₁ = 3.5

⇒ r₁ = 10.5 − 3.5 = 7 cm

⇒ Sum of diameters = 2r₁ + 2r₂ = 2(7) + 2(10.5)

⇒ Sum of diameters = 14 + 21 = 35 cm

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of a Circle

A circle is a closed two-dimensional figure in which the set of all the points in the plane is equidistant from a given point called the centre. Area = πr² and Circumference = 2πr.

Concentric Circles

Two or more circles that have the same centre but different radii are called concentric circles. The area between two concentric circles is given by π(R² − r²).

Semicircle

A semicircle is exactly half of a circle. Its area is half of the circle's area (πr²/2) and its perimeter includes the straight diameter edge, given by πr + 2r.
